poetry.title: Longing
poetry.preview: Describe it, how? When its reach feels far-fetched.
poetry.text:
Describe it, how?
When its reach feels far-fetched.
When reaching for myself is selfish.
As the reach itself decays.
We do not talk out of necessity, fear, or longing.
I hold this corner — hoping, wishing, pacing.
Is anything accomplished?
Shall I wander in perpetuity?
Shall I move on when time allows?
Neither feels right— or true— in this moment.
In the vastness — that is where we are.
I met you. I lost you.
All for the better, I ought to believe— of you, me, nature.
Nature never harms intentionally.
I did.
That is my cross to bear.
Or the cross I choose to bear?
So what then?
I sit and ask again and again:
What then?
No answers come. None shall.
Shall I learn to love the query?
Should it remain unsolved,
Would that be the end of me?
It has— for days, weeks hence.
If the goal is the journey,
And the journey never ends —
What then?

poetry.title: In My Own Way
poetry.preview: I hope to one day tell you, that I am scared.
poetry.text:
I hope to one day tell you,
That I am scared.
Because I love you.
So, I became scared of loving you.
I loved you the more for it naturally.
I even pretended to love you,
When I didn't think I could love you anymore.
Then I broke you.
Because, I loved you too much.
And me, not enough.

poetry.title: Parallels
poetry.preview: You held my heart, when I did not know how to love.
poetry.text:
You held my heart,
When I did not know—
How to love.

I broke your heart,
I did not know—
How to be loved.

poetry.title: Seeing Her
poetry.preview: Have you ever been afraid? Of losing something, that wasn't yours?
poetry.text:
Have you ever been afraid?
Of losing something, that wasn't yours?
Seeing her.
Felt like that.

I was scared, happily so.
Paralyzed by fear.
Not thoughts this time,
a lie.

Lost her anyway.
Get her, don't get her.

Spiraled into thoughts of unworthiness.
Paralyzed by thoughts anyway.

poetry.title: Yesterday
poetry.preview: I missed you, yesterday. Yesterday, I missed you.
poetry.text:
I missed you, yesterday.
Yesterday, I missed you
Today —not so much.

But Yesterday, every "I" ended with you.

Yesterday, you lingered on my mind
Like summer heat on paved roads.

Yesterday, Where waves kissed the rocky shore. For every teary-eyed infant,
For every cord cut.

Well, I missed you. I missed you
As if you were missing from me.

poetry.title: Yosemite
poetry.preview: We rode under the cover of night. The moon stood still.
poetry.text:
We rode under the cover of night.
The moon stood still.
Centered as chaos danced around it,
It glowed in the night sky.
It was magical.
They gave me joy,
And I hope I gave them some as well.
May we share this again someday,
No matter what the future holds.
I shall hold these memories hostage.
I will water them so they bloom
Into sunflowers and cherry blossoms.
May these memories bring a smile to your face.
The moon is no longer still,
Bright as ever though.
A crater staring back at me.
It's light guiding us through the night.
In truth, it is the GPS.
But how wonderful would it be
If it was us and the moon?
Us and a fire.
I yawn and crave my bed.
May you read these words one day and wonder if they are about you.
They are, and you will know.
Maybe you won't.
Until then, my friend.

poetry.title: KJ
poetry.preview: In the Aeroplane over the sea, we laughed until my sides hurt.
poetry.text:
In the Aeroplane
Over the sea,
We laughed
Until my sides hurt.

poetry.title: Dear Boy
poetry.preview: Oh! my dear boy. If you could see what I see...
poetry.text:
Oh! my dear boy.
If you could see what I see,
You would know love eternal.

Be brave.
Often paralyzed by fear.
Act, and the path will clear.

Sleeping,
Comfort begets death of dreams.
Wake!

Follow the river, past the bend,
The tree, free.
Chain your own thought.
Ask, ask for thy wisdom.

Sweet,
This heart, mine, tenderly.

I love you, always.

poetry.title: Waste It
poetry.preview: What an inconsequential run. Limited print. A fleeting moment.
poetry.text:
What an inconsequential run.
Limited print.
A fleeting moment.
So ephemeral.

What little of it we have.
Why, then, is so much wasted?
Somehow— we plan its waste.
Not the journey.
Not the destination.
But the company.

Waste it.
With the right people.
Waste it.

Time.

poetry.title: Where The Pole Stood
poetry.preview: This feeling is unmatched. Brought to you by shame and complacency.
poetry.text:
This feeling is unmatched.
Brought to you by shame and complacency.
Awoke to pole in the middle of my bedroom.
A pole tethered, as above so below.
Made of light wood.
Straight as an arrow.
Thick as a brick.
The pole does not move.
It moves not, it does not bend.
No, you may not chip away at it.
You must navigate this pole.
Immutable, non transferable— eternally steady.
Presence, presently felt.
The pole feels nothing.
No joy, pain, anger or sadness.
It reflects me back at me.
Woke up one morning and the pole was gone.
I sit where the pole once stood,
Only the void remains.

poetry.title: Loop
poetry.preview: I once had a thought— one that thought about itself.
poetry.text:
I once had a thought— 
One that thought about itself. 
It questioned its own roots 
Until it became a mirror.
Are all thoughts self-thinking? 
A thought that thought thinking... 
A waste?
If every thought thought, 
Would thinking be?

poetry.title: I AM GREEN
poetry.preview: Purple is such an ugly color. Violet— strikes me at my heart.
poetry.text:
Purple is such an ugly color.
Violet— strikes me at my heart.
It awakens in me a rage.
Violates me.
Yet, I am all the better for it.
Lavender, kisses me.
With the rhythmic pulse of the enamored.
They cannot hold me.
For—
I am green.
Like tree moss and anthurium.
Green like where the sun meets the sea.
Like eucalyptus vines and emerald days.
Call me—
Envy,
Grass,
Jealousy,
Do Not—
Call me purple.

poetry.title: Green Patches
poetry.preview: She was a kid. Hair ablaze.
poetry.text:
She was a kid.
Hair ablaze by green patches.
Salt of the earth.

poetry.title: Lament
poetry.preview: My own demise. Death comes for us all — a return to the self.
poetry.text:
My own demise. 
Death comes for us all — a return to the self. 
Destruction of the body, the soul left eternally free. 
A path. A journey. A mountain. 
What is it to be truly free? 
Free from the self, from others, from society?
Compare. 
Contrast. 
Nuance.
Call me Winston Smith. Call me O'Brien. 
I am both object and watcher. 
Endless — as if the end were something to fear.

poetry.title: Rejection
poetry.preview: Rain in its domain. Supreme. Light but heavy is the burden.
poetry.text:
Rain in it's domain
Supreme
Light but heavy is the burden
The souls crash
The heart disintegrates
The thoughts evaporate
Alone
In the dark
Out of reach
You run and run and run
In the dark

The line
A kid, an adult
A familiar chain
A familiar place
One in front of the other
We follow order
A break in line
Raised eyebrows
Shocked faces
The line
Why do we follow
The line
Why do we skip
The line
Who invented it
The line
When was the last time you thought about it
The line human Decline

poetry.title: As If They Were Watching
poetry.preview: What are you? A feeling? An ache — a moment?
poetry.text:
What are you? A feeling? An ache — a moment? The edge of an echo?
A heart in motion. Hungry for blood. Eyes wide open. Seeking salvation.
A solid pump. A silver blade. Two sharp jabs. The debt is paid.

poetry.title: Bicycle
poetry.preview: Two bikes. Two Christmas mornings. One mouth full of dirt.
poetry.text:
I've had two bikes in my lifetime.
One small and black.
The other tall,
red and blue.
Both Christmas presents.

One cycled me to death's door.
Gave exclusion,
Gave victory,
Scraped knees,
A mouth full of dirt.

Now.
I have thoughts.

poetry.title: Coffee
poetry.preview: Two hands cradle a mug. The eyes wonder in the distance.
poetry.text:
Two hands cradle a mug.
The eyes wonder in the distance.
A sip — transfer of warmth.
A pause — engage with the moment.

Cloth filled with ground beans;
work steady.
A smell as familiar as morning dew.
Rose-colored mumu.

Electricity in a sip.

poetry.title: Coffee (II)
poetry.preview: I take a sip, cradle the mug in my hands.
poetry.text:
I take a sip,
Cradle the mug in my hands.
The warmth now resides in me
Until my eyes and mind wander.

It's then I set it aside,
Bask in the moment.
I wish this would last.

poetry.title: Accept
poetry.preview: Oh you foreign child. Distant goal of mine.
poetry.text:
Oh you foreign child.
Distant goal of mine
I find myself at your feet
LIES— I find nothing at all
I seek, I seek — You!
Endlessly.
Your teachings.
In vain, I admit—
I Struggle, that is clear.
Accept, you must accept.
How can I?
Why should I?
I seek, I search.
Nothing.
No closer to the finish line than a car with no wheels.
I ask, I seek.
My wits about me
The never ending cycle. If I understand,
Then I will accept.
But I understand.
Yet— I only seek more understanding.
Accepting is foreign.
Like a wet tongue on your cheek.
Accept! Accept! Inwardly I scream.
You have all the understanding you need.
Why the will you not accept?
Whispers.
It is not enough.
Will it ever be?
I hope —
Someday.

poetry.title: This Is For You
poetry.preview: Yes, you this is for you. So you learn to forgive yourself.
poetry.text:
This is for you
Yes, you this is for you
So you learn to forgive yourself
So you learn to trust yourself
So you learn to love yourself
All those doubts and mind trips
All those pesky little things that drive you crazy
All the feelings you can't describe
All the passion you have inside
All those
Every single one of them they are okay.
You are okay.
You will be okay.

poetry.title: Pain
poetry.preview: Do I carry it on my back? Or hold it in my hands?
poetry.text:
Do I carry it on my back?
Or hold it in my hands?
Pain
How does it make you feel?
Where does it make you feel?
Pain
Do you even feel anything at all?
Do you remember what it felt like?
Pain
I remember nothing
But I remember pain.

opinions.title: On Opinions
opinions.preview: Opinions are armor and weapons. The only real difference between people is what they value vs what they give value to.
opinions.text:
Opinions are an ease by which any society creates and maintains standards. Those standards are applicable to a portion of the society, rarely all. Simple opinion, take Uggs : you may not have one as you don't wear any. You may be an avid advocate of theirs. You may not like their product yet remain silent, you evoke a sense of neutrality or indifference.

The issue isn't our opinions, rather how we communicate them. The issue is we can't have an unbiased discussion, everything we do is related to a thought, a feeling, a want, a need we've carried our entire lives. Say you make a decision about your life based on the opinions or advice of others it invites a feeling of uneasiness if the decision was bad. Even if it was good, if you were opposed to it in the beginning it still feels foreign. The decision not being your own leaves a bad taste in your mouth. In part opinions have become part of our identity. Opinions were an ease by which society created and maintained standards. Opinions are now armor and weapons used during an argument.

Next time you argue with someone, note how you feel after. You will see the range from winning or losing the argument will fluctuate with external factors ( did anyone raise their voice, did anyone cry, was anyone offended or offensive). The best way to win an argument is not to have the right opinion. It is to speak clearly about things you understand. Having the facts is well in good, but simply spewing them on the table amounts to very little. It amounts to a messy table where no one wants to eat their dinner. How do most people use their opinions thus?

Their use varies deeply depending on culture or the century. Once Humans started thriving on a difference of opinions it became an unstoppable machine. They differed on everything, is the difference to say they are different or are they actually different. A fact I can neither prove nor disprove since it has been embedded into our society as an opinion. If someone had a negative opinion on Uggs, you listing facts from their website would move them very little or not at all, you might in fact reinforce that negative belief. Changing someone's opinion is as hard as getting them to chop off their arm voluntarily. The only real difference between people is what they value vs what they give value to.

If you are entitled to believe what you want then so are others, do not leave your armor at home. In a society where we've been literally numbing ourselves for fear of bearing the full weight of human emotions without a chemical buffer now I must also bear your opinion of me. No thank you, literally.

The spread of misinformation is rampant and serves as building blocks for argumentative opinions. The little territories our ancestors divvied up claiming independence yet unable to survive without human hyper-connectivity is amusing. The interdependence of nations is as contrary to their independent claims as opinions are from fact.

opinions.title: Church and Ice Cream
opinions.preview: As a child I was very gullible. My mom promised me rum raisin ice cream if I went to church with her.
opinions.text:
As a child I was very gullible. When I was seven my mom promised me rum raisin ice cream (our favorite) if I went to church with her. I did not like church, I thought it was weird. The idea that an all-knowing creature required me to be somewhere specific at any given time seemed strange and a lame excuse to make poor people poorer.

We went to church that Sunday. I watched the pastor wipe the sweat off his brow as he yelled "God is good" and waited for the congregation to reply "All the time." The thought of ice cream kept me from squirming too much.

When it was time to stand for the sermon I could no longer see the pastor clearly. My line of sight was blocked by this lady in front of me, she had a large flowing white hat. She would raise her hand and the hat would ebb every time the pastor stomped his feet. He was adamant that he was a messenger of God and the congregation needed to give back to God to thank him for his blessings. Why did God never want you to keep your money. Money is the root of all evil and God is entirely pure. Only he could sanctify your money, through us of course.

Why did we need to give money to the church? Why did we need to pray together?

I don't have answers to those questions—none that would satisfy anyway.

Much of my time was casually interrupted to provide exaltation to a being that I never received a reply from. I was told to pray when I woke up, I was told to pray before going to bed. We prayed before class started, we prayed after class ended. We went to church on Sundays.

My whole being is bothered by the church. In such an unfathomable way that I look back at that child and almost pity him. I do not pity adult Christians, they have made a choice. My heart could ache for every Christian child but then I would give value to hell. The adults are led to believe that a mystical being that is all-knowing and all-powerful placed the pastor here for his purposes. His purposes most often involving guiding the congregation both spiritually and financially. We cannot forget financially.

I don't hate church as much as I hate the way it turns fair-minded people into dogmatic believers. I knew this doctor and his family when I was little. They were my neighbors and they were Adventist. The women were not allowed to wear pants. I thought as a child that doctors were educated. What do pants have to do with the will of God? The church did not invent dogma but as our records indicate it has made the best use of it.

I'm still waiting for that ice cream.

opinions.title: On Continuous Effort
opinions.preview: The bane of my current existence. The act of being aware that you are trying and that you will fail.
opinions.text:
I did not invent effort. Until recently that concept was not at all familiar to me. Effort here we will take to mean a determined and vigorous attempt. I think effort should not be classified under what people do but what people are. For there to be effort the attempt must be vigorous and determined. Yes, but an attempt can be made to look as such, therefore no effort was made but appropriately simulated.

Conscious effort seems to be the default since we are conscious we can drop that word. I think we should add another.

Continuous Conscious effort. The bane of my current existence. The act of being not only aware that you are trying therefore exerting effort but also that you will fail.

Failure is the greatest teacher no one seems to care about. I was deeply afraid of it. Now I bask in it against my will. I did not choose to fail, I know I must. I know I will, I know it is part of the process. My earlier attachments to the definition of failing have kept me tied up. They have kept me at war with myself over little failures and big ones alike.

I am not an expert in failure, I have failed many times however and each time I was harder on myself than I needed to be. This is a classic mind pitfall where what you know and how you know it does not merge. I know I must fail so why be my own enemy when I fail. Systems do not dissolve overnight. My view of failure was systemic.

I now make an effort to be less hard on myself. If it was easy and I had it figured out, this would be called I figured it out. Alas. I am better at noticing when the failure was within my control (requires more effort), and when it was not within my control (nothing I could have done to change the outcome). One lets me know where to improve, the other lets me know that I have improved.

opinions.title: The Mountain Doesn't Care
opinions.preview: I often wonder how much I can take of this panopticon. The mountain must be climbed however long it must take.
opinions.text:
I often wonder how much I can take of this panopticon. I wonder too much, even in my mind I slide into cascades of thoughts until they become an avalanche while I am still at the base of the mountain. It is an inexperienced climber that lets the distance between him and the top get to him. The mountain must be climbed however long it must take. Thinking about climbing the mountain does not move our feet, it does not move our heart. It breeds paralysis.

Paralysis of thought. When you undertake the future, overlooking the present and succumb to the past. Now, this moment here is the only true moment. It is the only one that exists and all others are imaginary versions of this moment. Some you lament. Some you hope come to pass. Neither does because you are not looking at what is in front of you. You look at what is ahead with complete disregard for what lies beneath you. You look at the past with utter disgust without recognizing that you are no longer there. The present is much harder to see.

The present is a present most have said. But what is a present one does not know how to make use of? I'm sure there must be a term for it, I do not know it.

Trash?

Perhaps, not quite though. A present one does not know the full utility of can become a burden. You may try to figure out all its uses rather than mastering one at a time. We know this. Knowing and avoiding the pitfalls of our mind is a game of battleships. One where we both know where the ships of the opposition rest. The winner then is decidedly who attacks first and the most. Your past self knows you very well, he knows when you are about to fall but rarely saves you. Why?

The most common line of reasoning seems to be that it must be protecting you from something. Someone? Yourself? All possibilities yet none come forth at this moment. If it is indeed protecting me from myself what do I seek protection from. A heavy heart is all that weighs on me these days. One where it would eclipse me to not speak of the love it holds. To let it bubble and fester within me as if it was shameful. It has been shameful to love at times. I have been shameful about my love of the self at times.

Shame and embarrassment are not unexplored emotions we carry from day to day. They are a living breathing part of our organism. Parts that I should treat with more care. Though they are temporary in reality the mind bends time and space to distort when they become too heavy. Yet it is only with familiarity that we must enable ourselves to recognize that these feelings are not negative they are instructive.

The lesson learned from them will last a lifetime. I have attended the classes but I seem to retain none of the information when it truly matters. The mind would sooner drown itself than detach itself from non self-serving identity.

opinions.title: Anchor
opinions.preview: We have looked into the depths of our soul. We have waged war against the void, the darkness, the never ending ocean.
opinions.text: We have looked into the depths of our soul. We have waged war against the void, the darkness the never ending ocean. Know your enemy, spend as much time with them as you would your friends. You learn to embody them, you learn to let them crawl on your skin and overpower you. You learn that you are only as resilient as you believe you are when you are anchor-less. In this world you need an anchor, for many of us it is other people. Child, significant other, I have neither. Sure there are other anchors, pleasure, pain, achievements, recognition. But for most of us it is other people. Those anchors are solid, alive and reciprocal. Those anchors guarantee a sense of safety and purpose. I want to find an anchor that I can rely upon, rather than seeking anchor should I build one? Should I realize that I am already building one. Realize that it is heavy and a burden, that it breaks and breaks me in the process. Realize that the void and the anchor are at war over the foundation of our being. That this process came at my request and now I need to choose not only the anchor, the foundation but the systems in which we will use to advance our goals. Our goals will shift as we align ourselves more with who we are but we must choose with what speed and intensity we will pursue them. We cannot be lackluster, or lackadaisical about this pursuit. We cannot be half in half out, we must embody the pursuit like we embrace the dark. We must let it wash over us like waves in the ocean and carry us to shores unseen. It is easy to speak in hyperbole and see that we are far from where we want to be. It is easy to see how far we must go. It is hard to admit that the only way is through and one step at a time. It is always hard and knowing this does not make it easier. Nothing really makes it easier when you wage against nothing. It all feels pointless at some point and that is the point where motivation dies. Kant is not for the faint of heart but we must continue in these muddy waters. If anything sways you or moves you in a direction in which you do not want to go, it is a sign that you are not yet anchored. Like a swell in the chest, your breath gets heavier and you start to wonder where you are going and if you must go. You go and you drown. You've drowned plenty and now you wonder if you want to drown at all. You know you must break a thousand times to solidify yourself but upon breaking at the 100th you wonder where the courage to break 900 more times will come. You have abandoned the hope that motivation alone will carry you that is good. Consistency is the only vehicle you have left and it is the most boring path ever, it does not excite, you fear, and the dopamine will not let you forget. Do not forget once we came. Do not forget once we struggled to do what feels basic now. Do not forget that getting here was not mere luck but practice and patience. I know you feel like both are at their limit but you are merely an impetuous child, one who has much to learn, in the ways of being, becoming and the world. We forget so easily. We slip into the past like old clothes and bad habits. We forget. We forget. We wonder why we forget as we forget still. It is an infernal loop human memory. So we learn, we forget, we strive, we fail, we loop. Squabbling creatures in the dark unaware of what lies in front of them because they are busy staring off in the distance at what could be or ought to be, but cannot for the life of me focus on what is. We spoke of anchors and tethers, we spoke of what keeps the boat steady and what the waves take with them. We spoke of what we embody and how we do it. It's not a fantasy that we live but a reality in which the right thing does mostly nothing. It mostly does nothing, like it doesn't move the flames of the heart in any particular direction. You could do the right thing for 50 consecutive days and feel more adrift and lost at sea than you did when you did the wrong thing. So what does doing the right thing bring, what does it accumulate to that successive days should be a goal, an achievement. I don't have an answer for you. But I know that doing the wrong thing disables me from putting a roof over the foundation. That the foundation is what is the most important thing we can have besides the anchor. That the foundation remains when everything else is gone. That within the depths I saw it, like a sinking ship in the night disappear into the waters submerged once again by that great darkness. Yet you are here at the page, not anywhere else. Present against the thoughts that would drag you to the bottom of your being. I have been there, I have seen it. I have stared it in the eyes and I have been honest with it. Left me emptier than the water aisle at grocery stores during a hurricane. Yet we muster. We put on our boots, we wipe our tears and we muster. Ahead. Lonely. Alone. We muster the courage to put one foot in front of the other and scream into the void you may break me a 1000 times but you will not own me. I am my own, and no I may not believe it entirely now, someday I must. Someday is not today but today is the reflection that someday might bring. Anchored you are not, anchored you haven't been. Anchor that anchor you seek, you found and rejected because you knew not what it meant to be anchored. Now you beseech it to come back and it won't. You must build your anchor, you must build your foundation, You must build anything you want to rely on otherwise you must watch it crumble again and again. So what keeps me going, what anchors me now. All my goals are not the goals of a dreamer, are they? What goal keeps you going now. None, to be fair, I stopped looking at goals to get me going, I don't know what keeps me going, maybe it is a giant ball of shame. Maybe it is the dreams of a younger me in which I found something I can accomplish. Maybe it is that I have become accustomed to fighting the void, the nothing, the wasteland that no other adversary would suffice. Maybe I have fooled myself into thinking that I need something to go on when going on in itself is enough. I do want to go somewhere though. I don't want to be confined to the likes of the now. My destination is far from where I am I can feel it in my bones. I belong somewhere. Something out there even by accident created me and imbued me with a sense of something. Something I can't quite explain but it hungers. Call it intuition. Call it space, void or purpose. Call it what you want but it keeps me going. When my knees bleed and my voice breaks, when my chest tightens and it hurts more to keep going than to give up something picks me up and says I must go on. If not for myself, for who, for what? Simply to go on. Because the earth will shake and the foundation will be rocked, will it stand tall? Will it crumble? I look at my hands for nothing else could build it.

letters.title: A Hard Day
letters.preview: I learned that the part of me most attached to life would rather die than let go.
letters.text:
I learned that the part of me most attached to life would rather die than let go. I learnt that no one is coming to pick me up no matter how much I cry. I get up and will myself towards what I want, or I sit in a puddle of my own making. Will power is not enough I know this but it is currently one of the few things I have that work in my favor. I can be obstinate in the face of unwavering odds. Today was hard. It was hard to place my thoughts into an order where they supported me. I know that some days are going to be hard. I however have not been the greatest at dealing with hard days. This is me trying. Writing to see if the escape is in my words or in my mind willing it to come forth. But I know no answer will come, repetition and consistency no matter how boring are the only way forward. I stopped being able to see more than half an inch in front of me. Searching for meaning in the dark. What do you do when you need your hand held or your soul cajoled? A question for a mentor I have none. A question for my parents, I have witnessed their systems and I do not wish to follow suit. Wasted potential. It often feels like I am walking backwards trying to fix the mistake of the past instead of trying to have a better future. This is a hard day. I will get through it. But man this is a hard day.

I could list all the things that make today hard. It is not one thing. It is the sum of all things being heavier than usual. It is that extra second in bed second guessing why? It is the usual heartache with a slight sting. It is the inability to find joy in the progress, knowing there will not be joy yet I must enjoy it regardless. It is a tiny little needles that wait patiently for my will to drop as I do unto them. It is every thing and nothing all at the same time. It is the void whispering the obstacles in my ear. It is myself not affording me the care I wish from others. It is a multitude of things I know but don't know where to begin to fix. So I circle myself like small boat left to the sharks. I want answers, they cost, I thought I was willing to pay. You get depleted faster than you get replenished. You love to hate. Even yourself. It is so easy after all. Yet I love myself. I really think I do. Otherwise whom am I doing all this for? So the question is not what remains when will power fades but what you build to sustain yourself regardless of will power. What do you build. What do you believe sustains the person you are. The person you are becoming. The person you hope to be someday. What feeds is drive, is motivation to go further, do more, be more. He is accomplished so all seems easy but what about when he was you, struggling to see the light. What kept him going during those long nights. Fool yourself into thinking you are farther than you ought to be only to do less than you ought to do. Do not be so naive. Get up, brush the dust off and go again, even when your tiny brain screams stop.

letters.title: A Journey
letters.preview: I wasn't sure what I was going to write when I started this.
letters.text:
I wasn't sure what I was going to write when I started this. I had an idea to write a letter to you but I think I will let my brain take us on a journey. A journey of self discovery. What do you want to talk about.

Yesterday mostly, the conversation ended on a positive note but I can't get carried away. I will try to manage my undertone I guess. I don't mean to talk like you still love me, my tone is mostly about the fact that I still love you. Not in the way of boyfriend girlfriend. I won't lie and say I'm not attracted to you. I am. But the love I have for you is the love you carry for a person over the course of your life. Not maddening love. Not enthralling love. Steady and Continuous love. Love that doesn't fade with time, but reasserts itself. You said you did not love me anymore. That hurt but I respect it. I spent a year learning how to love myself. The only thing I concluded is HOW THE FUCK DID YOU DO THIS FOR YEARS?

I am not saying I am unlovable I do have parents. I am not an easy person to love. I am complicated unnecessarily so at times. I realized all the ways I did not love myself. I am still learning how to be patient and understanding with myself. To know that I will fail sometimes and that is okay. I am harder on myself than anyone I know, at least that is what I think. I want to thank you for loving me because at the time I did not love myself. I loved a version of me that I failed to become and live up to. Shattering that glass mirror left me in shambles. I was scattered everywhere. I tried so many things to relieve the pain. I tried so many times to build myself back up. I failed every single time.

I am still trying, the difference is I no longer see failure as an obstacle I see it as fuel. That failure tells me I need to change something. What I don't know. So I'll start small. I'll change one thing or i'll change nothing but be more enamored with what I already do. When that fails I adjust. Some days the failure looms over my head like the old days. Like I am battery being drained. When I get in my head like so, I spiral and almost nothing can bring me back. I have to wait till the next day, till my internal clock is at peace with what happened.

When I say thank you for loving me I mean it. You did not have to. You did not love me in a way that made it so I had to live up to something, you loved me for who and what I was, even if I did not love myself then.

Loving myself. I don't know how to explain that I did not love myself. I doubt I have to, looking back at my actions it was clear. A squeezed water bottle will continue to pour out water until it cannot anymore but that does not mean there is an abundance of water. When I couldn't anymore I had to ask myself why? I had to ask myself what I wanted? I had to ask myself if I had it and did not know how to take care of it. I did not like the answers, so I kept searching. I lost myself. I had to. I had to simply because I could not keep being who I was.

letters.title: Letter to Kiwi
letters.preview: I've been thinking about you lately far more often than I had over the past months.
letters.text: I've been thinking about you lately far more often than I had over the past months. I do find it strange and I wish I could reach out. Somewhere the fire still burns within me. I think that is unfair to everyone involved but pretending otherwise is far more cruel. I hope you are well. I miss licking the salt off your skin. I think that is love. Maybe its desire and passion only but why can't it be both. I am not sure I hope you think about me, the thought of us both lacking courage strikes me as odd, but it might be respect, I wish to honor it. You don't have to be honorable you know. I do think I am funny, maybe someday you'll read this and think the same. The time was short but somehow I remember it vividly and with great detail, mostly I remember because I like shaming myself into feeling guilty, the things I ought to have told you. I practice them in the mirror like a bad actor. Because someday I hope to be courageous enough to tell the person I love, I love them. Not by saying it but by finally letting them inside my head. Too many times I think when you tried to reach for me and where I was I retreated inside my shell to make myself seem unreachable when the only thing I wanted was to be held. I wrote this because you have crossed my mind multiple times in the last two weeks. I hope this is a symptom of who and where I am. Oh how we often long to change the past, I have imagined the scenario too many times. The first few times I imagine it where it happens in my room. Then I imagine it with my phone in my hands still able to change things with a phone call or a text. Then I imagine it on instagram when I saw your feet up on the dashboard. Then Imagine it outside your house that night, not to change anything there I think I did all I could but I like to imagine it went down differently. Then I imagine when you came over, not the first time, the second time. The first time I think went about as well as it could have, I was still in disbelief when you showed up. The second time, I thought I was being chivalrous, honorable, decent. My coworkers sent me the Billy Joel innocent man song when I told them what happened. My mind processes it like a missed opportunity sometimes but I think my heart sleeps better because of it. The third time though was it, coming back a third time, but you remained steadfast and it ended there. I think also about the phone calls we had in Orlando and San Jose it felt like a cat and mouse game, except neither of us was the mouse. I think that's it. I think there is more but maybe another time.

letters.title: The Brown Dress
letters.preview: There is a part of me that still cherishes the memories and times we shared.
letters.text: There is a part of me that still cherishes the memories and times we shared. That part of me is the gentlest kindest part of me and it wants you to know that it will always love you as a person that was kind to me. That I will never forget and is one of the reason why I haven't blocked you tbh. It's starting to feel like your words don't match your actions and how could I be with someone like that. Part of me wants to understand how overwhelming and confusing showing up your house must have been and I hold no grudges towards you I just want to heal in peace. I want to be afforded the same kindness I show others. I understand that I wasn't always the best to you and I'm sorry for that. If this is your way of making me suffer or getting revenge congrats for the most part it worked. I don't blame you however everyone is entitled to seek justice how they see fit.

letters.title: The Kiwii
letters.preview: With New York constantly on my feed these days I cannot help to think about you.
letters.text:
To Zee,

With New York constantly on my feed these days I cannot help to think about you. However brief our time was it did leave a lasting impact on me. One that cannot entirely be conveyed in simple conversations.

There are things I wish I had told you when we were together and there are things I wish I had never told you once we fell apart. I am for the most part in agreement that though I knew how to communicate I was not a big fan of it because to often I focused on the reaction I would get rather than the stew that bubbled inside me.

This is a reflection of a child who learned when to be quiet and not why to be quiet. When it came to avoiding conflict let's just say the spirit of the cards was amongst my biggest supporters. Being someone who projects as antagonistic or contrarian it does strike me as odd that in relationships with people I love I avoid discomfort like politicians avoid accountability except I was better at it. I still observe myself in the act and beat myself up later about it. I don't know the conditions for which I seek discomfort with others so that I may be at peace, shifting the burden as never to me seem a good trade off.

I do miss you from time to time, when you brush up the things I regret it does not take long to find you. That is both a compliment and an insult. The sequence of events that allowed you to be in my life is the most regrettable time in my life, I would not change anything about it however. I am here as the product of all those actions and contradictions. I have to believe that they needed to happen for me to be able to write this because they did happen, and I am writing this.

I had been under the dizzy spell that the past needs to be changed, a notion that falls in line with how we experience time rather than how time flows, forward only. It does not look back precisely because it knows once it happens it happens and changing it would only create something new.

I procrastinate on this letter because it is an admission that I loved you and I lost you. But I do not think of them in the same vein. I think about loving you as a pleasure and an act from which I derive fond memories. I think about having lost you as the inevitable cost of being me. Sometimes the hardest thing you do is believe you deserve love. You gave me yours freely I refused to accept it, it was like watching a pattern emerge and choosing to not stop it.

I'm a future olympian in mental gymnastics and unnecessary retellings of the past. I am soft to the touch and childish when it matters most. Broke every toy in a fit of rage then cried myself to sleep. Is this for you or for me, neither, maybe both, it shall exist nonetheless. I hope you are well.

letters.title: Zariah
letters.preview: I wrote the previous paragraph last year, about the time that you left.
letters.text: I wrote the previous paragraph last year, about the time that you left. I regretted it, letting you leave, letting you slip through my fingers without letting you know how I truly felt because I was a coward. You came back and told me you were happy and you had no romantic feelings towards me. I was crushed for the second time but I had grown familiar with the feeling and part of me believe I deserved the pain. It was then hard to fight and easier to let go. But I told myself that if I didn't fight with everything I had I had no right to even be sad about losing you because I did not fight to keep you. Then I showed up at your house, uninvited, in the middle of the night and questioned your happiness and your relationship. You assured me that both were in good standing and you were happy. That was on February 12th 2025. On march 13 2025 almost a month later, with no contact cause I dare not contact you and hoped you would do the same. You asked me for restaurant recommendations for your birthday. I was shocked, bewildered even. My first thought was how could she be so audacious, how could she ask me that with such confidence and zeal. How could her reaching out to me not be an assault on my person. I wanted to yell and scream. How dare you? Instead I went over the situation in my head and with my circle and decided to give you three recommendations anyway. Thinking I can't believe she asked me that question, why doesn't her man plan something for her birthday how could she think about me and my feelings so casually. I was hurt but in the back of my mind the pain was not the measure of what I put you through therefore I was willing to suffer through it. Then I had hoped that would be the end not because I wished it to be but because you have a significant other, one that hopefully loves and cherishes you so why contact me at all. I was by all accounts confused and sad. Sad because you know how I feel about you so why must you use it against me. Sad because you told me you were happy but you don't behave like a happy person. Then you called me on a Thursday around 11 and I thought oh no. Because I wanted you to come, I wanted to hold you, kiss and love you like never before. Then I remembered, you have a man and I am not him. You have a man and he is not me. You have a man and me and him are not the same. You didn't come over either because you never intended to or because you felt I wouldn't be welcoming. At any rate that night I told you how I truly felt about you and apologized for my behavior. You got really quiet and didn't say anything else and said you wished to talk no further. Strange you called me to Yap according to you so when did you run out of things to say. I thought this would be the end of it or at least hoped. Part of me really wants you to be happy even if it's not with me. And for that reason I don't feel capable of being your friend, because either am still rooting for your partner's downfall. Not in any meaningful way just the way my brain thinks about you. I only wished for the space to grieve the person I loved but could never bring myself to say it. That night I felt so relieved telling you and I now recognize that it might have been unfair to you and for that I am sorry. A month ago if you had asked me how I felt about you I would have said I have love for you and I am willing to explore that love and see where it goes. Now I wonder why all these games, they feel unnecessary to me but I want so badly to give you the benefit of the doubt but I am running out of patience and understanding, the amount of space you take in my brain and the time I spend wondering how you feel, where you are, what are you doing, are you thinking about me, are you going to text me back, do you think about me as I think about you, the questions bounce back in forth between my occipital and frontal lobe like a never ending match of ping pong.

letters.title: Zee Zee
letters.preview: I apologize if I have done anything to offend you. Yesterday I was in a bad mood.
letters.text: I apologize if I have done anything to offend you. Yesterday I was in a bad mood. I had asked my sister to do something and she hadn't done it. It was the third time in as many days I had asked her to do this one thing. Now I know this might not seem like much. Ended up doing it myself which was okay but I personally don't ask them for much. At least that's how I feel. So coming home and since it still wasn't done just complete pissed me off and I wasn't very pleasant to be around even my siblings spent the rest of the day/night in their room and did not talk to me. Probably wondering what that has to do with you. Matter fact don't even know why I am writing this explaining myself to you. I apologized already and told you I would make it up to you and now you not picking up and not answering my texts. Usually that would bother me but it really doesn't you do what you think is best for you and honestly I support that. But I know if the roles were reversed and I was the one ignoring you this would unfold very differently. In any case I hope you have a good day. If this is you ghosting me I wish you nothing but the best and hopefully you find what you were looking for. Sorry if I made you feel anything but good about yourself. You are a very beautiful person inside and out. Like me you have your flaws nothing that gets in the way of your beauty or how bright your soul shines. I would like to apologize if you ever felt like you had to dim your light. If we ever meet again I hope we can be friends or at least cordial.

letters.title: Another Unsent Letter II
letters.preview: This might be liquor in me but I'm feeling a tingling sensation...
letters.text:
This might be liquor in me but I'm feeling a tingling sensation that I will be able to write something beautiful over the next couple of days. The feeling not only stems from the multitude of sips I took from this mimosa but also from a deep, deep place in my heart. My days are still overshadowed by thoughts of her, but lately realized that I had an issue finishing anything I liked too much, because I never wanted it to end but I actively sought the end. I pushed everything to the edge and hoped that whatever stared back was something beautiful. Negotiated with death on trivial matters. I walked the path alone yet we were an ensemble. I have many regrets.

The title of this reads I love this woman. But one question remains unanswered amidst all of this turmoil. Why did you think it was okay to hurt her as such. I did not think it was okay. I knew it was wrong but that did not stop me. Why you ask? Because then I did not know what I had. I am not saying that was the reason.

I did not know what I had, I did not feel worthy of it, I was terrified. Those are all excuses that do not engage the behavior or the underlying cause of the problem. Because two things can be true at once even when they seem opposite. I love this person and I hurt this person. This seems like an easy thought to follow because those two feelings are not ever adjacent when one talks about love.

Lest we forget that part of love is our ability to endure. Not only at the cost of our own comfort but for those who cheer for us when no one else is. Part of me will always try to explain what happened as best I can. Not because I need an answer. The answer to me is simple I was selfish, afraid and arrogant.

Those are the things that lead me there, but what lead me to those things. Invariably a multitude of things. For one my inability to communicate any discomfort. This is two fold, whenever I needed space I was afraid to ask, because I had already been categorized as distant and it had been a topic of contention I did not need to prolong any further. This is not to shift blame, it was my responsibility to communicate you do not reside inside my mind. All too often we hope that someone will realize something we have not told them. All too often they do, but it is rarely the thing we wished they had noticed.

Arrogance, I thought I could get away with it. Not in the long run but I thought in this moment I could. Because then I was at my lowest. I needed to feel in control of something (this statement bothers me mostly because it is true in a way I cannot explain yet). I was also jealous of your progress. I did not know how to articulate that. Not jealous in the sense that I did not wish for you to succeed. If anyone deserves to succeed it is you. Jealous because I became afraid that I would no longer be enough for you. Enough to provide the life that you want. Which made me resent myself and in turn you for making me resent myself. A simple conversation could have solved both issues. At the time I did not know how to articulate those issues. It may seem simple now but it was anything but.

Fear is a component of my life that I engage with everyday. It is not one that I discuss with many people however (until recently I discussed it with no one). I have many fears. That I will never be enough. That I will never find love. That I will never get out of poverty to name a few. Yet I was enough for someone, I was loved by someone. I was too busy looking at the fear to realize what was in front of me. I seek neither absolution nor forgiveness. I don't think I deserve them.

I now realize that thought was absolutely stupid, why did I care what those people thought. They weren't real, the only person whose thoughts I should have been concerned with were yours. I am so sorry for that.

It may seem like I have an inability to move on. I may as well state here that I do. Moving on to me seems contrarian. If it keeps you tied to me in a way you do not wish to be that is worse. I do not want worse for you. I may have to accept that I am not the best for you.

If I should move on, and I have thought plenty about this. I have no wish or desire for another person. Not because I shall love you for the rest of my days (I will, I have no choice in the matter, it is futile to fight it, admit it and move on.) but rather my love for you seems to endure time not as a dimension but as a condition.

letters.title: Dear Rubny Emile
letters.preview: It has not been easy being you. It has been even less easy becoming you.
letters.text:
Dear Rubny Emile,

It has not been easy being you. It has been even less easy becoming you. I go on regardless because to stop is to die, and I am not ready for either. In this life, we must, we will get everything that we want, firstly because we have no other recourse, secondly the other option is death. Not literally but slowly over time like a good soup. You are the soup, you become the soup. I do not want to be soup. I want to make soup. Therefore the life we live must be one that is active, not passive. We need to define what that means in part because at times we seem content with being passive. A passive life involves the required belief that we are incapable or that something is impossible. The only thing that is truly impossible is what we believe is. The funny thing about belief is this, if you keep repeating something enough you will be right once. That is all it takes however to convince others that such should be relied on as proof. If a politicians screams enough times that the other party is blocking them from passing a bill at some point the other party will be blocking them from passing that bill. What you speak as two consequences what you said and its opposite effect. Because what you said directly affects belief. Affect not effect because it will either be in the positive or negative. Once you have spoken, you either bring people on your side or bring people against you, knowing how to manipulate both sides of that coin is how people rise to power. Say you believe there is nothing you can do your passivity enables the activity of others. As humans we find comfort in either opposition or in being part of something. Why? What about those that are alone, passivity is a form of contribution whether you intend it or not. The choice, lack of choice, or the semblance of either is how the interconnected world survives. Why do I tell you this, I just remembered this is a letter to you. What you believe matters, it matters more than anything. It is also detrimental in a way that cannot be accounted for, see opposition above. You must believe, even when it seems impossible, especially when it seems impossible. Your belief is what others attach their belief to. If you waver they waver, your opposition is only here to test your ability to believe in any situation. It is hard, no doubt, we doubt. We are naturally skeptical. We are introspective and question way too much to let anything be attributed to chance, yet we must. We must relinquish our right to an explanation and trust in the nature of things even when things seem contrary. In this I think about Hemingway, he was right about one thing 400-500 good words a day, what it does for the soul and the practice is immeasurable and compounds. I wrote way more than that but child go, we have a canyon to see.
